messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by team Dune, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team saw that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- On 2026-02-11, Oskar wrote the feature-flags handover document for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team flagged the reports pipeline as not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to 2025-12-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- As of 2026-03-03, the auth gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-03]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]

Question: When can feature-flags be deployed?
